title: first fortnight of progress on my god game using opus 5.5
author: Sarcospam
selftext:
hey all :)

im creating a god game called Divine Influence, and have been using opus 5.5 for alot of the stitching together.

in the first two weeks of work i have a tutorial and a first level, no content level wise but getting all the mechanics in first

shown in my little youtube video is: god creatures, villagers, god hand interactions, cutscene, island preview

no sound sadly. all models are going to be replaced later with better ones XD

im really getting into making this and i love it, i love god games and want to make one that id want to play

let me know what you think, i know its not much to show yet im just excited.
